I can do that, but I don’t have your full sheet — I can’t invent values or evaluate formulas beyond the single example you gave. I can either (A) tell you exactly how to flatten/export to CSV locally (fast), or (B) flatten it here if you paste the full Model tab rows (A2:A8, B2:B8, C2:C8, any other referenced cells such as D12) or upload the file.

Quick options — pick one:

1) I’ll do it here if you provide:
- All rows you want flattened (e.g. A2..A8, B2..B8, C2..C8), and
- The value in cell D12 (since E9 uses D$12) or any other fixed cells referenced.
Paste them in plain text like:
A2: widget a, B2: 12.50, C2: 400
A3: ...
…then I’ll compute D (B*C) for each row, compute D9 (SUM of D2:D8), compute E9 (D9 / D12), and paste the resulting CSV.

2) If you prefer to do it yourself quickly:
- Excel:
  - Open the Model sheet.
  - Select the whole sheet (Ctrl+A), Copy (Ctrl+C).
  - Right-click -> Paste Special -> Values (this replaces formulas with computed values).
  - File -> Save As -> Choose CSV (Comma delimited) -> Save.
- Google Sheets:
  - File -> Download -> Comma-separated values (.csv, current sheet).
  - Or: select all -> Edit -> Copy -> Paste special -> Paste values only into a new sheet, then download that sheet as CSV.

3) Example using only the single row you gave
Given:
A2 = widget a
B2 = 12.50
C2 = 400
D2 = B2*C2 → 5000.00

If you want a CSV with a header row and that single flattened row, it would look like:
A,B,C,D,E
widget a,12.50,400,5000,

(E left blank because E9 depends on D9 and D12 which you haven’t provided.)

Tell me which option you want. If you want me to produce the full CSV here, paste the rest of the rows plus the value for D12 (and confirm the row range, e.g. rows 2–8).
